description: THE divergence, pinned. Three parts authored at opacity 0.5, each keyed to a different value held across the whole clip. Under the settled rule a key REPLACES Part.opacity, so 'toHalf' resolves 0.5, 'toFull' resolves 1.0 and 'toQuarter' resolves 0.25. Under the multiply reading the server used to implement they would resolve 0.25, 0.5 and 0.125 -- every one of them plausible, none of them throwing, and all four vertex kernels still bit-identical.
